coverageNotes: INCOMPLETE: this run found no new venues. What I did instead: read the seed for the area (Nakuru 14 rows incl. Kizigenza, Milimani, Legacy, Almico, Waridi, Kabarak spa/fitness; Laikipia/Nanyuki 3 rows: Achievers, Olympia, Nanyuki MMA Wing Tsun; Narok 4 rows: Lions Fitness, Narok Fitness & Kids, Red Rock Gym, Karen Blixen Camp; Morendat/Naivasha-side 1 row: Play With Fitness; no seed rows at all for Naivasha town, Gilgil, Molo, Nyahururu, Ol Kalou, Baringo/Kabarnet) and opened the three seed websites for the area with WebFetch. Results: kizigenzafitness.com returned an empty page (JS-rendered, no text extractable); playwithfitness.com returned only the title 'PlayWithFitness - Get Strong, Get Healthy, Get Happy' with no address/phone/hours (also JS-rendered; /contact gave the same); milimanifitness.co.ke did not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND), logged as an unverified lead above. None of this produced new evidenced facts, so no seed venue is re-listed as a candidate. County by county: Nakuru town, Naivasha, Gilgil, Molo, Laikipia (Nanyuki, Nyahururu), Nyandarua (Ol Kalou), Baringo (Kabarnet) and Narok were NOT researched beyond the seed; the absence of candidates says nothing about whether more gyms exist there. Naivasha, Nyahururu, Gilgil, Molo, Ol Kalou and Kabarnet have zero seed coverage and are the highest-value targets for a rerun, along with hotel/resort gyms (Naivasha lakeside, Nanyuki/Laikipia lodges, Mara camps) and Kabarak/Egerton/Laikipia university gyms.
